question: Who must sign the Authority to Release Personal Information form?

claims.text: The Authority to Release Personal Information form (IMM 5475) must be signed by the applicant and, as applicable, their spouse or common-law partner if they also wish to release personal information to the same designated individual, while dependent children 18 years of age or older must complete their own form.
